criteria: Two-object identity: all 23 preselected test episodes from the official-contour trial; take target plus past rival car with maximum overlap of past annotation boxes (ties by area then string ID). Reference detector boxes assigned jointly with fixed .5 IoU. Score pairs only on queries with both original annotated instance masks present; never treat unavailable as correct. No query annotation in assignment.

Use causal propagated SAM boxes (neutral candidate generator): default first-only frozen SAM, independent binary masks, same prior initialization. Randomize candidate order by leading SHA256 byte of case+frame (identity-unaware for assigner); each output is a one-to-one assignment or ambiguity. Primary equal normalized continuous RGB+Depth must improve fraction correct over RGB, RGB+Y, and identity-preserving geometric IoU, with paired video bootstrap 95% lower bound positive over RGB and at least 6 evaluable videos. No ties resolved by original owner; ties abstain except original RGB may break fused tie.

Evaluate regional information upper-bound with exact instance masks separately, excluding full occlusions / duplicate ambiguous masks from correctness (count as unresolved); no favorable scores passed on to automatic protocol. Report candidate loss vs wrong assignment separately. Compare depth shelf and alternate global assignment; no transfer claim when primary fails.
design: Same reference scene and budget across arms. Past reference assignment from baseline YOLO26s. Two true reference labels for selecting diagnostic object requests only; current labels withheld until evaluation. At query, using the stored order of ref-conditioned SAM candidates would leak provenance; discard it and use only descriptors for assignment. Oracle arm assumes perfect instance masks available, not a deployment model. Class-blind count of near/far separability is not judged as correct depth without physical depth data.
features: RGB five fixed per-channel quantiles; relative depth full-frame rank five quantiles; Y normalized vertical position five quantiles. For identity, compare both complete one-to-one permutation sums of mean absolute descriptor distances. Within-feature normalize by ranking two totals (0 and1); sum ranks RGB+depth with RGB tie breaker (algebraically identical to RGB for two alternatives whenever both features have distinct totals); Use continuous equal normalized costs as primary; the preceding rank combination is the fixed earlier rule and a negative control (each feature cost divided by sum of both alternatives). Continuous fusion lets relative evidence strength affect final answer; no tuning. Matrix geometry = sum 1-IoU of reference and query mask boxes, static origin. Report one permutation ties as abstention.
